question.text: Vindhya Event-Driven Fund posted AUM of INR 420 cr (Jan), INR 448 cr (Feb peak), INR 425 cr (Mar), INR 392 cr (Apr trough), INR 410 cr (May). What is the Maximum Drawdown (MDD) over this 5-month window?

explanation.text: The Logic: MDD = (Trough − Peak) / Peak, using the LOWEST trough AFTER the highest preceding peak. Peak = 448 (Feb), subsequent Trough = 392 (Apr). MDD = (392 − 448)/448 = −12.50%. The Trap: -7.37% uses Jan-Apr (ignores Feb peak). -13.39% uses Feb-Mar but wrong math. -5.60% uses Apr-May recovery arithmetic. Note: The workbook also flags that MDD does not indicate recovery time; ratio combinations such as Calmar and bespoke LP dashboards are not part of the syllabus.
